cluster.label:
READING KEY + NON-NEGOTIABLES | All integrations/components proposed; no deployment or trading. Native AWS icons show AWS roles; orange external boxes are separate trust domains. Repeated store views are logical contracts, not extra provisioned tables/buckets.
Separate dev/prod authority and data. Current work: synthetic local/dev fixtures only, no AWS loading. Full requirements + UX agreement gate implementation. Static/SSR, workflow, region, data-store fit and ML A/B remain open.
£100 all-in cash envelope (£70 operation + £30 reserve); forecast alerts/reduce/pause at £60 / £75 / £85. Gross usage, shared credit and cash differ; no automatic paid fallback or universal instant billing stop. Business audit is separate from short-lived operational traces.
S3 originals: renewable 24 months with owner deletion/extension; no automatic deletion authorised. Monthly focused recovery / audit checks. Science: no random splits, leakage or premature grading; owner model promotion required.
Sources: MP architecture blueprint + DEC-001–041, 1 Nov 2026. Saved diagram explains direction/sequence, not live telemetry. Existing health/volatile SSE/site preview do not implement these capabilities.
